source: PoE Wiki / community crafting tables. Approximate historical distributions — not invented item recipes.

alchemy.description: Orb of Alchemy on Normal → Rare

veiled-chaos.description: Veiled Chaos Orb — rare reforge including a veiled mod

harvest-reforge.description: Harvest reforge including tag (unlocked side or full)

regal.description: Regal Orb Magic → Rare adds exactly one affix
